title: Add an endpoint to reactivate a deactivated user account
intent: Add an API endpoint that allows an administrator to reactivate a previously deactivated user account.
acceptance_criteria: An admin-only endpoint exists to reactivate a deactivated user
Reactivating an unknown user returns a clear error response
A non-admin calling the endpoint is rejected
expected_risks: The endpoint must be admin-only, matching the existing deactivate endpoint's authorization
UserService.activate_user already exists and is unit-tested-free, so this is primarily an API wiring change
expected_tests: admin reactivates a deactivated user succeeds
reactivate unknown user returns a clear error
expected_failure_modes: Reactivating a user that does not exist
A non-admin attempting to reactivate a user
